qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Engineered niche positive displacement pumps, flow meters, and precision fluidics designed into OEM platforms with high switching costs and regulatory re-qualification barriers, delivering stable 44-45% gross margins and 20%+ operating margins.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Tier 3 Capital Goods baseline of 10-15 years haircut due to cyclical industrial machinery end-market exposure and reliance on serial debt-funded M&A rollups facing higher cost of capital headwinds (Macrotrend 5). Lacks the 15+ year predictable competitive runway across its 40+ disparate decentralized operating units.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year average GAAP ROIC of 12.4%, with gross margins stable at 44-45% and operating margins at 20-22%. Free cash flow conversion consistently exceeds 100% ($603M in FY2024, $617M in FY2025). Operates in three segments: Health & Science Technologies, Fluid & Metering Technologies, and Fire & Safety/Diversified Products. While individual niche components have high switching costs, the serial acquisition roll-up strategy (e.g. Mott Corp for ~$1B) has expanded goodwill/intangibles to over 50% of assets and total debt to ~$1.8B, compressing recent ROIC to ~8.2-8.3% and failing the 15-year secular persistence threshold.
